name: Quality HVAC by Fibid
verdict: The biggest movement this period is the 1,300% spike in leads week-over-week (paired with an 86.88% drop in CPL), almost certainly driven by the 83.71% increase in spend and Meta's 18 leads at $682.46, which together pulled cost-per-lead down sharply. Note that GHL shows 1,597 opportunities created against only 18 tracked leads, and both systems are marked active and reconciled, so the volume gap between pipeline entries and attributed leads warrants a closer review.

performance.verdict: CPL collapse is real but 9 overdue milestones block any scale-up.

findings.text: CPL fell 86.88% to $91.55 on Meta's 18 leads — efficient, but 3-day lead signal (Oct 3–5: 0+1+0) shows the burst stalled immediately after Oct 1–3 spike.
9 SOW milestones overdue (earliest Jul 31): intake owner unconfirmed, booking bot untested, heating campaigns not live — scale-up gate explicitly blocked per SOW.
GHL shows 1,597 opportunities vs 18 attributed leads — a 88x gap indicating a pipeline data integrity or intake classification issue, not an ads volume problem.
GBP actions dropped 64% week-over-week; Quality HVAC Solutions call rate is 0.0147 (14 calls on 954 impressions) — organic call conversion is weak and declining.
Google Ads spent $965.38 over 28 days with 3 zero-spend days in last 5 (Oct 3, 4 show $0) and only 10 logged conversions — pixel attribution unreliable, not spend efficiency.

suggestions.text: Confirm intake owner and GHL seat access — unblocks scale-up gate and validates 1,597 vs 18 lead gap.
suggestions.monday_update: The intake owner has been unconfirmed since Vivian left 7/7; this is a hard blocker on all budget increases per SOW. GHL shows 1,597 opportunities against 18 attributed leads — the seat or pipeline classification needs to be audited before those numbers can be trusted. Action: Nacer confirms who owns intake, provides their GHL login, and documents after-hours coverage. Success check: intake owner named and GHL pipeline audited by 2026-10-10.

suggestions.text: Escalate 3 overdue heating deliverables (LSA re-enable, heating campaigns, heating content) — heating season is live now.
suggestions.monday_update: LSA heating toggles were due 2026-09-01, heating campaigns on Google and Meta due 2026-10-01, and heating/furnace content due 2026-09-30 — all overdue as of today 2026-10-06. With heating season underway, every day without these live is lost demand. Action: Sohib to convene Ads and Web/SEO departments this week for a hard ship date on all three. Success check: all three items have a confirmed live date logged in Monday by 2026-10-09.

suggestions.text: Watch Meta lead rate through Oct 9 — 3-day signal (0+1+0 leads) suggests Oct 1–3 burst may not hold at current $20–28/day spend.
suggestions.monday_update: Meta delivered 18 leads at $91.55 CPL in the 28-day window, but the last 3 days (Oct 3–5) show only 1 lead on roughly $62 combined spend. The Oct 1–3 burst (3+3+0 leads) may have been a short surge rather than a sustained rate. Monitor daily lead count and CPL through Oct 9 before any budget move. Success check: if 3-day lead rate returns to 1+ per day by Oct 9, flag for a budget conversation pending intake-owner confirmation.
